queuePolicy: Atomic same-file GitHub blob SHA compare-and-swap for claims; fetch current main file & SHA, modify only claimed task, update_file with original SHA; on conflict re-fetch/reselect. Do not claim work with overlapping edits simultaneously. Only one active task per chat. No automatic lease stealing.
